title: Supplemental Use Regulations Along 125th Street
previewText: Within the Special 125th Street District, for any zoning lot that fronts upon 125th Street, the use regulations of the underlying districts shall be modified by the requirements of this Section, inclusive. However, on through lots or corner lots with frontage along 125th Street, such requirements shall apply within the first 100 feet of the 125th Street street line.
